== Biography ==
'''James Glasgow''' was born around '''1810''', likely in '''Ireland'''. He was the son of '''James Glasgow''' and '''Peggy Slowne''', both natives of '''Scotland''' who had settled in Ireland. James grew up in a family with Scottish roots, and he would go on to marry '''Jane Ramsey''', a native of '''County Tyrone, Ireland''', daughter of '''John Ramsey''' and '''Jane Patterson'''.

James and Jane had at least one son, '''James G. Glasgow''', who was born on '''June 11, 1833''', in '''Ireland'''. The family was part of the large wave of Irish emigrants during the 19th century. In '''1851''', their son James G. emigrated to the '''United States''', eventually settling in '''Illinois'''.

It is not known if James and Jane emigrated with their son, but their family continued to have strong connections to Ireland and Scottish heritage. James likely spent his life working in agriculture or related fields, as his son would later become a farmer in the U.S.

No further details are known about James Glasgow’s later life or death, but he was part of the Glasgow family's lasting legacy in both Ireland and the United States.
